coordinatorReview.reviewNotes: Trivial mechanical string-replacement story. Coordinator correctly skipped speckit (no security surface, no edge cases). Not blocking for this scope but worth noting if the codebase has broader references. Pipeline added minimal value, which is the correct outcome for a defect this simple.
